result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Neither answer treats the spec as essentially sound: both rewrite it in full, and both add the same multi-page Done flow and handling for incomplete drafts at submit. A splits several items into sub-lists, but most of its edits fix real ambiguities: the missing Waiting for signal state, which state wins when several apply, and the 10-second undo window in item 5. B keeps the original layout and says items 1, 4 and the submit confirmation are fine, but it adds more scope: an Upload failed state, reading the merchant from the photo, markers on guessed values and an accessibility note. A wins narrowly. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Neither answer treats the spec as sound: both reprint the whole spec and add more than a few edits, though both keep the core decisions (no save step, undo instead of a delete confirmation, the specific submit confirmation). A keeps the original prose and structure, and most of its changes are fixes to real contradictions, but it also adds new behavior (an Upload failed state, markers on guessed values, an accessibility note). B rewrites more: it turns items into bullet lists, adds a state priority order, and makes the camera close after each single photo. That last change is new behavior and could slow down reps capturing several receipts in a row.
